items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Roy Evans played with Sam Morgan.

ctx.x: Well, I had another fellow I used to like. Mm-hmm. His style was a little different, but I liked that beat he had. That was Roy Evans. Mm-hmm.
Who was he with then? Roy Evans played with Sam Morgan. Oh, yeah.
David Jones had a six-piece band. Poin-el played alto.
